programme.desc: Reborn in a dating sim as a comic-relief side character with unexpected hidden powers, Kousuke, armed with extensive knowledge of the game, seeks a happy ending with the heroines he admires.

programme.title: Magical Explorer Ep10
programme.desc: Reborn in a dating sim as a comic-relief side character with unexpected hidden powers, Kousuke, armed with extensive knowledge of the game, seeks a happy ending with the heroines he admires.

programme.title: The Ancient Magus' Bride: Ep15
programme.desc: The students are studying hard as the exam approaches. During a short break, Rian challenges Philomela to a game. Rian wins by a nose, but he does not seem to be happy at all.

programme.title: The Ancient Magus' Bride: Ep16
programme.desc: Chise is paired up with Veronica for a 'test of courage'. Chise asks Veronica about Philomela. With a smile on her face, Veronica begins talking about Philomela's background.

programme.title: The Dangers in My Heart Ep2
programme.desc: Yamada invites Ichikawa to her home for the first time. Nervous while bathing, Ichikawa realizes that he forgot his underwear. While trying to retrieve it, he sees Yamada in loungewear!?

programme.title: The Dangers in My Heart Ep3
programme.desc: Ichikawa and the girls are having a sweets-making party at Yamada's house. Yamada's mother is suspicious of a Ichikawa's presence. Sekina and Ichikawa act as couple, but Yamada feels uneasy...

programme.title: Ensemble Stars! Ep1
programme.desc: Yumenosaki Private Academy specializes in producing male idols. Idol students Subaru Akehoshi, Hokuto Hidaka, Makoto Yuki and Mao Isara begins the testing-phase 'Produce Course'.

programme.title: Ensemble Stars! Ep2
programme.desc: While Trickstar plan their revolution in secret, Rei Sakuma, one of the 'three oddballs' proposes to provide support. Meanwhile, the DreamFes 'S2' between Ra*bits and AKATSUKI begins...

programme.title: Ensemble Stars! Ep3
programme.desc: Yumenosaki Academy falls deeper into the student council's control. The members of Trickstar conclude their individual training and prepares for the 'S1' against AKATSUKI as a group.

programme.title: Ensemble Stars! Ep4
programme.desc: On stage, UNDEAD launches their surprise attack at AKATSUKI, followed by 2wink's performance. Amidst the battlefield, Trickstar make their appearance. What will be the battle outcome...?

programme.title: Ensemble Stars! Ep5
programme.desc: After S1, Nazuna of Ra*bits learns that Eichi is discharged from the hospital and starts recollecting the happenings over the past year, when he was still a member of Valkyrie...

programme.title: Ensemble Stars! Ep6
programme.desc: Last Fall, Yumenosaki Academy fell under the student council's control after they introduced the Dreamfes system. As a result of avoiding live showdowns, Valkyrie fell from their top spot.

programme.title: Ensemble Stars! Ep7
programme.desc: Trickstar is called out by the student council. Their president Eichi Tenshouin demands the disbandment of Trickstar and orders the transfer of each member to a different idol unit...

programme.title: Ensemble Stars! Ep8
programme.desc: Trickstar is now broken apart and as Subaru stumbles over his reason for becoming an idol, RYUSEITAI, led by Chiaki Morisawa, appears before him...

programme.title: Ensemble Stars! Ep9
programme.desc: The DDD commences as the Yumenosaki idols compete to represent the academy at the SS. Meanwhile, Subaru is on his way to rescue Makoto, who has been confined by Izumi Sena of Knights...

programme.title: Ensemble Stars! Ep10
programme.desc: Trickstar aims for the DDD with three members-Subaru, Makoto and Mao. Eichi and Keito are trying to carry out a plan after electing the 'Five Oddballs' who would represent the academy.

programme.title: Ensemble Stars! Ep11
programme.desc: To fight against the Five Eccentrics, Eichi's new idol unit 'fine' commences their activities. Under the new DreamFes system, they steadily gain popularity...

programme.title: Ensemble Stars! Ep12
programme.desc: The second match of the DDD semifinals begins. Led by Eichi, fine takes on UNDEAD which is led by Rei. As Eichi makes his resolve, Trickstar makes their appearance on stage...

programme.title: PUELLA MAGI MADOKA MAGICA SIDE STORY MAGIA RECORD 2nd SEASON -The Eve of Awakening- Ep6
programme.desc: Left alone to fight Magius, Kuroe hears her Doppel's voice. Witches gather in Kamihama according to Magius' plan. On the way to meet Iroha, Yachiyo runs into the magical girls from Mitakihara City.

programme.title: PUELLA MAGI MADOKA MAGICA SIDE STORY MAGIA RECORD 2nd SEASON -The Eve of Awakening- Ep7
programme.desc: Iroha and Madoka's party struggle to fight their friends Tsuruno and Mami, who are now under Magius' control. Meanwhile, a large supercell is approaching and its true form is the Walpurgis Night.

programme.title: Sacrificial Princess and the King of Beasts Ep13
programme.desc: Leonhart is unable to accompany Sariphi on her next task as queen's representative. While putting together a personal guard for Sariphi, one demonfolk steps up and volunteers himself.

programme.title: Sacrificial Princess and the King of Beasts Ep14
programme.desc: As captain of the queen's personal guard, Lanteveldt accompanied Sariphi to Mahsuya. Lord Brown was attacked by an assailant as Lanteveldt falls under suspicion and is taken into custody.

programme.title: Tune in to the Midnight Heart Ep7
programme.desc: Rikka attempts to create an original song to gain an old friend's acceptance again, but she thinks it's beyond her current abilities. Just when she is about to give up, Arisu appears.

programme.title: Tune in to the Midnight Heart Ep8
programme.desc: Nene's activities with the drama club aren't going well. Arisu heads over and sees her getting criticized. Unable to express her character's emotions as she wants, Nene grows frustrated.

programme.title: The Cold Sato-san Is Only Sweet to Me Ep8
programme.desc: Koharu Sato is known as the 'cold school beauty.' At his family's cafe, Sota discovers an unexpectedly endearing side to Sato. On top of that, it turns out the two have a mutual crush on each other!?

programme.title: The Cold Sato-san Is Only Sweet to Me Ep9
programme.desc: Koharu Sato is known as the 'cold school beauty.' At his family's cafe, Sota discovers an unexpectedly endearing side to Sato. On top of that, it turns out the two have a mutual crush on each other!?

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas Ep3
programme.desc: Step into the Bay of Fundy's surging waters. Learn how this east coast ecosystem sustains an abundance of creatures.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas Ep4
programme.desc: Travel along the west coast of Great Britain, where the world's longest uninterrupted footpath forges through more than 800 miles of breathtaking scenery.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas Ep5
programme.desc: Explore an island surrounded by the mighty Atlantic ocean, subjected to pounding waves and driving rain.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas Ep6
programme.desc: Journey to the wild Pacific coast on the western shore of Vancouver Island in British Columbia.

programme.title: Rooted Ep1
programme.desc: Across rippled dunes, in the wind-swept grasslands of the southern Kalahari towers a magnificent Camelthorn. It has stood here for two centuries.

programme.title: Rooted Ep2
programme.desc: Discover the story of the much loved Sausage Tree, whose nectar filled blooms and sausage shaped fruits entice animals of all kinds, from insects to elephants.

programme.title: Rooted Ep3
programme.desc: In a misty South African forest grows a six hundred year old Outeniqua Yellowwood. At forty meters tall, she towers above the canopy and is one of the few remaining of her kind.

programme.title: Rooted Ep4
programme.desc: The Namaqua Rock Fig Tree stands rooted on the slope of a rocky hill in Namaqualand, South Africa. It is the ultimate survivor, able to withstand the unforgiving conditions.

programme.title: Rooted Ep5
programme.desc: This is the incredible story of a tree that has been around for eight hundred years... that can withstand the harshest conditions...

programme.title: Boss Shark
programme.desc: Witness the ultimate battle for dominance as scientists try to pick out the alpha male in a pack of 100-plus great white sharks off the New Zealand coast.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway Ep1
programme.desc: Embark on a dangerous tagging mission in South Australia that will show what sharks eat and why they gather in feeding hot spots.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway Ep2
programme.desc: Track a pregnant shark along the Great Barrier Reef and see if she leads a team of scientists to her hidden pupping ground. Then search for signs of mating along the southern coast.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway Ep3
programme.desc: Stay up late as the northern team attaches an activity tag to a bull shark and finds out what this night owl does after sunset. Then dive 80 meters deep with the southern team.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway Ep4
programme.desc: Ponder shark community hierarchies as the northern team studies how young blacktips learn social and survival skills. Then rush to Rainbow Beach with the southern team.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway Ep5
programme.desc: Travel to the ends of Australia's shark highways. Find out if Greenly Island in the south is a truck stop for migrating great whites, then search for proof of a genetic connection between the sharks.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway Ep6
programme.desc: Follow the southern team as they test new migration tech and tools that could reduce shark attacks in a popular snorkelling spot. Then catch and tag bull sharks with the northern team.
